bibliographic.title: I Knew A Guy
bibliographic.author: MelArtwoeger
bibliographic.description:
! CW: References to suicide !

A small dialogue spreading awareness about suicide.
Inspired by the Dialogue Jam from NeoInteractive, where through dialogue or written correspondence, "aims to bring discussions forward".
 
This is perhaps an incomplete prototype of what I want to make, an interactive story made to spread awareness about a serious topic I care about, and I would like to come back to better bring this story to life soon, possibly when I have more developed skills in game development.
Any feedback is welcome, I'm here to improve, and to eventually share my story.
Thanks, and enjoy
-M
